comments.body_html:
How to Fix if this mod breaks your install

Hey everyone, if you install this mod and it breaks your install and still can’t load SPT after removing it here is what you can do.

Find your character’s profile at {spt}\ user\profiles. If you’ve made multiple accounts, there there will be a file here for each one. Just find the one for the character you tried to log in as with scavcat.

Once you have that open, ctrl+f for ‘SCAVCAT’ and delete the whole json element with the null resupply time.

I’m curious if setting the null there to the resupply time listen in the db\base would fix the mod, but figured I would wait for an update instead.

comments.author: AdmnInferno
comments.body_html:
Ive kinda made this mod work again using the AdvancedTraderFramework mod.

Step 1: Download both AdvancedTraderFramework and the most recent version of SCAVCAT
Step 2: Go to zzzAdvancedTraderFramework>db>traders and copy the ‘zNewModdedTraderExample’
Step 3: Paste it back into the traders folder and rename it SCAVCAT
Step 4: Open TraderConfig.JSON and change “enabled” to true, along with “modifyAssort” and “modifyBase” and save
Step 5: Open base.JSON and change “working” to true (NOTE: IF you change the id in one place you have to change it everywhere else) and save
Step 6: Open TradePackages>DefaultTradePackage>assort and delete all the contents but leave the folder

Step 7: Open SCAVCAT (OG mod) > db ,copy assort.JSON and paste it into the assort folder in the ATF mod
Step 8: Then move ATF into your user>mods folder

lmk if you need help Admn Inferno#6571
